name: Angus McMillan
bio:
Angus's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with racing games and a knack for dismantling and rebuilding computers. He honed his skills with a degree in Computer Science, later specializing in data management and network infrastructure. His initial foray into the industry was at a local racing team, where he quickly became indispensable for his ability to optimize data flow and troubleshoot IT issues on the fly.

At Birel ART Factory, Angus ensures the team's complex IT infrastructure runs seamlessly, from telemetry data analysis to communication systems. He's known for his meticulous approach, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve data accuracy and security. He thrives on the high-pressure environment of the pit lane, always ready to adapt and resolve any technical challenge that arises. His experienced approach to his role makes him a valuable asset to the team.

Angus's perfectionist tendencies mean he's never satisfied with 'good enough'. He's always looking for ways to improve the team's IT systems, and his dedication is unmatched. He is very friendly with other department staff, and ensures he understands their needs regarding the IT systems.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Angus is of average height with a lean build, often seen sporting a focused expression.

Has a habit of tapping his fingers when concentrating.
Drinks copious amounts of black coffee throughout the day.
